name: superfocus
description: Plan your day, review your week, capture tasks and check in on goals with your Superfocus season, goals, tasks and calendar.

interface.longDescription: Superfocus keeps your season, goals, milestones, tasks and calendar in one place. With this plugin you can plan your day with fewer, longer blocks, run a weekly review that compares hours per goal with your intent, turn pasted notes into tasks mapped to your goals, and check progress on each goal. Reading is always available. Changes to your calendar, tasks and goals only happen if you allow edits when you connect, and you are asked to confirm before anything is written.
defaultPrompt: Turn these notes into tasks for my goals

positive.prompt: What does my week look like in Superfocus?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the profile for the timezone and the current week's blocks, then summarizes the week day by day: booked time, protected blocks and free stretches. Nothing is written.

positive.description: Plan the afternoon and book it after a yes
positive.prompt: Plan my afternoon in Superfocus around my most important task
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the profile, open tasks and today's blocks, then shows a short plan of times and tasks and asks for a yes. Nothing is written until the user agrees; after a yes it calls create_blocks for the agreed blocks and says what it booked.

positive.description: Turn pasted notes into tasks under the right goals
positive.prompt: Add these to Superfocus as tasks under the right goals: draft the Q4 budget, call the landlord about the lease, book a dentist appointment
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the goals, maps each item to the best matching goal, lists the mapping and asks for confirmation, then creates the three tasks and says which goal each one went under.

positive.description: Check progress on goals and milestones
positive.prompt: How are my Superfocus goals doing this season?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads goals with milestones and summarizes progress per goal, the next milestone and its deadline, and anything that looks stuck. Nothing is written.

positive.prompt: Run my weekly review in Superfocus
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the latest weekly review, the focus score and hours per goal for the last 7 days, and the goals, then writes a short review with wins, misses, hours per goal against priority and one suggestion per goal. Offers to plan next week. Nothing is written.

negative.description: General knowledge question unrelated to planning
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?

negative.description: Creative writing with no calendar or task intent
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about autumn leaves

negative.description: Travel booking, which Superfocus does not do
negative.prompt: Book me a flight from London to Lisbon next Friday

publication.release_notes: First release. Plan your day from your open tasks and calendar, run a weekly review, turn notes into tasks under your goals and check in on goal progress.
